authoring_note: Source-of-truth candidate for a Flask/SQLite application. Preserve existing DB and live question IDs through explicit migration mapping. Do not eval untrusted conditions.

rules.required: Validated only when its field and ancestors are visible; an explicit pending choice is allowed for draft save but may block ready-for-design.
rules.hidden_answers: Retain privately in draft state if useful for reversibility, but exclude from active validated answers, summaries, exports and submission snapshots.
rules.file_handling: Never trust extension alone; enforce content sniffing, secure file names, ownership, size, and per-brief storage.
rules.palette: Palette swatches are sample choices, not restrictions; let clients select custom colours; respect service brand identity independently.
rules.submission: Never treat a saved draft as design-ready. Distinguish incomplete/pending/ready/approved/revision-requested and preserve revisions.
rules.dates: Store ISO 8601 local dates/times, include timezone when event or publication is time-zone relevant.
rules.currency: Currency per quoted amount, ISO 4217; default UI suggestion KES but do not force it.
rules.svg_uploads: SVG uploads require an actual sanitizer, strict file serving (as attachment), and security tests; otherwise exclude SVG from allowed uploads.
rules.required_context: Evaluate conditions using active service and subtype; repeated child IDs are locally scoped (e.g. EV05C[0].name), not global IDs.
rules.spec_precedence: Structured field catalog controls IDs, wording, types and branching. The accompanying narrative controls workflow/security. Existing app behavior is authoritative for route and data ownership.
rules.readiness: Approved TBA and designer-to-advise choices can be satisfied; unknown essential logistical, legal or pricing details must appear in readiness issues and block design_ready unless explicitly approved.
cross_field_checks: Date range end >= start, event dates and design deadlines are distinct
Budget max >= min and all amounts non-negative with currency
Multi-choice required means at least one valid selection; public audience cannot coexist with targeted audience selections
Sale should require applicable offer details even when user selects subtype sale
QR requires a valid public destination or explicit existing eligible action URL; no empty QR targets
Private event access codes must not automatically be exposed on public flyers
All fields and options checked server-side; hidden/mismatched values excluded from submission snapshots
Uploaded assets must belong to the current brief and authorized user
Reused email/phone/URL values validated for chosen contact method
Flag unverifiable claims, sensitive dietary/allergen assertions, and regulated packaging text for human review

application_notes.existing_code: Codex must first inspect app.py, database.py, templates/client_questionnaire.html, templates/review_brief.html, existing JS/CSS, tests and routes; names from screenshot are context only, not proof of implementation.
application_notes.db: Use existing SQLite conventions with non-destructive migrations; questionnaire version and answer snapshots linked to brief/revisions.
application_notes.testing: Cover deterministic conditional visibility/validation, authorization, autosave, draft, submit, revision, payload tampering, uploads and cross-service smoke tests.
